text: dsh-tasks-panel 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 侧栏任务面板。它在侧栏和主面板注册任务入口，并用宿主存储保存任务与事件。用户可添加、完成、重新打开和删除待办，在月历中查看每天的任务变更，也能通过助手的 task_write 工具管理同一份列表。可选配置飞书群机器人 webhook 后，带日期和时间的任务会收到到点提醒。适合希望在 DSH 会话中记录待办并回顾进度的人；无需提醒时不必配置外部服务。

dsh-tasks-panel adds a task panel to the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar. Users can manage dated tasks, review event history in a month calendar, and let the assistant use task_write on the same list. Configure a Feishu group bot webhook to receive reminders for tasks with a date and time.
想在 DSH 里随手记下要办的事，还能标记完成。
有没有能在侧边栏管理待办和截止时间的面板？
让助手帮我把任务加进清单，之后也能查询和勾掉。
我想按月份回看每天新增或完成过哪些任务。
任务到时间时，能不能发条飞书消息提醒我？
想把完成过的事项重新打开，继续跟进。
I want to keep a dated to-do list inside my DSH workspace and review what I completed each day.
Can my assistant add and update tasks, then remind me in Feishu when an appointment is due?
dsh-tasks-panel 的功能「待办管理」：在侧栏面板添加带日期和时间的任务，并完成、重新打开或删除任务。新增事项默认设为当天，时间默认取下一个五分钟刻度。
dsh-tasks-panel 的功能「任务日历」：月历按日期标出任务事件，选择某天即可查看当天记录的新增、完成、重开、编辑或删除事件。
dsh-tasks-panel 的功能「助手任务工具」：助手可通过 task_write 查询待办、添加任务、完成、重新打开、编辑或删除任务；操作与面板共用同一套任务逻辑。
dsh-tasks-panel 的功能「飞书到期提醒」：配置飞书群机器人 webhook 后，宿主定期检查同时设置了日期和时间的待办，在到期后的六小时内发送提醒；同一日期时间槽只推送一次。
dsh-tasks-panel 使用前须知：飞书提醒会把任务标题、日期、时间和可选备注发送到配置的飞书机器人 webhook；不启用提醒则不会进行该推送（见 index.js:131-164）。

中文 · English

A to-do list, a calendar of what actually happened, and a push at the exact minute — inside DeepSeek Harness.

dsh-tasks-panel README · dsh-tasks-panel：Most task lists ask you to live in them. This one lives where you already work: it is a sidebar
panel of the DeepSeek Harness app, so the agent can add and close tasks through a tool, and you can
check or edit them without leaving the session you were in — plus a Back button that puts you right
back where you were.

dsh-tasks-panel README · What it does：| | |
| --- | --- |
| 🗂 **Sidebar entry** | One more icon in the rail. Click it for the panel, or use **Back** to return to the session, Plugins, Schedules — whatever you left. |
| ✅ **To do** | Add, complete, reopen, delete. The date defaults to today, the clock to the next five-minute mark, and `×` clears the date for undated notes. |
| 👀 **Today at a glance** | Hover the sidebar icon: a floating agenda lists today's tasks with their times, anything overdue, and how much is still open. No click, no context switch. |
| 🗓 **Calendar** | Every event — added, finished, reopened, edited, deleted — is drawn on the month grid. Click a day to read its log. |
| 💬 **Hover preview** | Point at a task or a day for the full card: title, note, due date and time, source, session, timestamps. Cards dodge the sidebar instead of covering it. |
| ⏰ **Feishu reminders** | Paste a group-bot webhook once. At the due minute the host pushes `⏰ title / time / note` to your phone — and closes the task, so an appointment you kept does not sit in the list waiting for a click. |
| 🤖 **Agent tool** | `task_write` lets the assistant add and close tasks — same operations as

dsh-tasks-panel README · Install：```
plugin_manager install_bundle target:"dsh-tasks-panel"
```

Or point `target:"<absolute path to a local checkout>"`. The first time the panel opens, a short
guide walks through the three things worth knowing — write a task, hover the sidebar for today,
paste a webhook for reminders. Both the UI and the guide are bilingual (中文 / English), following
the app's locale.

dsh-tasks-panel README · Reminders：Reminders follow one rule: **a task is reminded only when it has both a date and a time.** A date
alone is a to-do for the day, not an appointment, so it stays quiet.

dsh-tasks-panel README · Reminders：| Rule | Why |
| --- | --- |
| The host scans every 30 seconds | DSH must be running; a closed app cannot push. |
| One push per `date` + `time` slot | `notifiedFor` remembers, so a re-start does not re-notify. |
| Moving a task to a new time re-arms it | An appointment that moved deserves a new reminder. |
| A slot more than 6 hours old is marked, not pushed | A laptop asleep overnight should not dump yesterday on you at 9 a.m. |
| The switch saves by itself, webhook included | Pressing the switch then forgetting Save is how "enabled: false" happens. |
| A delivered reminder closes the task | An appointment that has happened is done; coming back to tick it is busywork. Turn **Close the task once it is pushed** off to keep tasks open. |
| Only a real push closes it | Tasks skipped by the six-hour window stay open — silence is not completion. |
| `task_write` has no reminder action | Turning on a push to your phone is your decision, not the agent's. |

dsh-tasks-panel README · Reminders：The panel shows the last send time and the last delivery error, and **Send a test** proves the phone
receives it before you trust it with anything real. Signature-checked Feishu bots are supported by
pasting the secret too.

dsh-tasks-panel README · Data：Everything lives in the `dsh_tasks` storage domain: `tasks` and `events` tables plus a `global`
record for reminder settings. The browser half talks to the host over
`POST /api/dsh-tasks-panel/op`. Nothing leaves the machine except the Feishu push itself.

dsh-tasks-panel README · Data：`zod@3.25.76` is vendored under `node_modules/zod` because a bundle installed by link
(`"dsh-tasks-panel": "link:…"`) does not get its dependencies installed by pnpm. An npm install pulls
zod from the registry instead, so the published tarball deliberately does not ship `node_modules`.

dsh-tasks-panel README · Development：```bash
npm install     # zod for the host half, jsdom + react for the UI suite
npm test        # runs the three suites in order
```

dsh-tasks-panel README · Development：| suite | what it covers |
| --- | --- |
| `node test/host.mjs` (38 checks) | storage ops (`add`/`complete`/`reopen`/`update`/`remove`/`clearCompleted`), time normalisation, the HTTP-op surface, the `task_write` tool |
| `node test/reminders.mjs` (34 checks) | Feishu scheduling: due detection, one push per slot, the six-hour grace window, auto-completion on delivery, the one-shot sweep of tasks reminded before 0.5.2, signature signing, error reporting, the settings guard |
| `node test/ui.mjs` (73 checks) | the client half rendered in jsdom: slot registration, to-do rows, all three hover cards, the compose form's defaults, the first-run guide, the settings card with both switches |

dsh-tasks-panel README · Development：Everything runs against the real bundle — no mocks of our own code. The host suites import `index.js`
with a fake Cordis context and in-memory tables; the UI suite loads `client.js` through a stand-in
`window.__ModuleLoader__` and renders the panel into jsdom. No network: Feishu calls go to a stub
`fetch` that records the payload it would have sent.

dsh-tasks-panel README · Development：GitHub Actions runs the same suites on Node 20 and 22 for every push and pull request, and publishes
to npm from a tag through OIDC trusted publishing (`.github/workflows/`).

中文 · English

一个待办清单、一个能回看「每天发生了什么」的月历，还有到点推到你手机上的提醒 —— 都在 DeepSeek Harness 里面。

大多数待办清单要你专门去用它。这个住在你已经在工作的地方：它是 DeepSeek Harness 的一个侧栏面板，助手可以通过工具加任务、勾任务，你也可以不离开当前会话就查看和修改；面板还带一个「返回」，看完直接回到刚才那个会话。

dsh-tasks-panel README · 功能一览：| | |
| --- | --- |
| 🗂 **侧栏入口** | 侧栏多一个图标。点开是面板，点「返回」回到你进来之前所在的地方（会话、插件、自动化任务……）。 |
| ✅ **待办** | 添加、完成、重新打开、删除。日期默认今天，时间默认下一个 5 分钟整点，`×` 清空日期就变成没有截止日的备忘。 |
| 👀 **今天一眼看完** | 悬停侧栏图标浮出今日日程：今天的任务与时刻、已逾期的事项、还有多少没完成 —— 不用点开、不打断当前状态。 |
| 🗓 **日历** | 每个事件（新增、完成、重新打开、编辑、删除）都画在月网格上；点某一天读那天完整的记录。 |
| 💬 **悬停预览** | 鼠标指向任务或某一天，浮出完整卡片：标题、备注、截止日期与时间、来源、会话、时间戳。卡片会避让侧栏，而不是盖住它。 |
| ⏰ **飞书到点提醒** | 粘一次群机器人 webhook。到点那一刻，宿主把 `⏰ 标题 / 时间 / 备注` 推到你手机，并把任务标记完成 —— 已经发生的约会不该还躺在列表里等你点一下。 |
| 🤖 **助手工具** | `task_write` 让助手添加、完成任务 —— 和 UI 是同一套操作，所以两边永远不会各记一份。 |

dsh-tasks-panel README · 安装：```
plugin_manager install_bundle target:"dsh-tasks-panel"
```

也可以用 `target:"<本地仓库的绝对路径>"` 装本地版本。第一次打开面板会出现一个简短引导（写一条任务、悬停侧栏看今天、粘贴 webhook 配提醒），文案跟随应用语言，中文 / English 都有。

dsh-tasks-panel README · 提醒规则：只有一条总规则：**同时有日期和时间的任务才提醒。** 只有日期的是「今天要做的事」，不是约会，所以保持安静。

| 规则 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 宿主每 30 秒扫描一次 | DSH 得开着；应用关着没法推送。 |
| 每个 `日期` + `时间` 只推一次 | `notifiedFor` 记住，重启不会再吵一遍。 |
| 改到新时间会重新提醒 | 改期的约物理应再响一次。 |
| 过去超过 6 小时的时段只标记、不补推 | 笔记本睡一晚，不该在早上九点被昨天的安排刷屏。 |
| 开关自带保存（连 webhook 一起存） | 「点了开关却忘了保存」正是 `enabled: false` 的经典成因。 |
| 推送成功就把任务标记完成 | 约会已经发生，回来再点一次是纯体力活；不想要可以关掉「推送后自动标记完成」。 |
| 只有真推送才自动完成 | 因为超过 6 小时被静默跳过的任务保持未完成 —— 沉默不等于做完。 |
| `task_write` 没有开关提醒的动作 | 要不要推到你手机是你的决定，不是助手的。 |
dsh-tasks-panel README · 提醒规则：设置卡会显示最近一次发送时间和最近一次投递错误；**发送测试**能在你真正依赖它之前证明手机收得到。飞书机器人开了签名校验，把密钥也填进去即可。

dsh-tasks-panel README · 数据：全部存在 `dsh_tasks` 存储域：`tasks`、`events` 两张表，外加一条 `global` 记录保存提醒设置。浏览器半边通过 `POST /api/dsh-tasks-panel/op` 和宿主通信。除了飞书推送本身，没有任何数据离开这台机器。

`zod@3.25.76` 以 vendored 形式放在 `node_modules/zod`，因为用 link 安装的 bundle（`"dsh-tasks-panel": "link:…"`）pnpm 不会给它装依赖。从 npm 安装时会正常从 registry 拉 zod，所以发布的 tarball 故意不带 `node_modules`。

dsh-tasks-panel README · 开发：```bash
npm install     # 宿主半边的 zod，UI 测试用的 jsdom + react
npm test        # 依次跑下面三套
```

| 测试 | 覆盖什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `node test/host.mjs`（38 项） | 存储操作（`add`/`complete`/`reopen`/`update`/`remove`/`clearCompleted`）、时间规范化、HTTP op 接口、`task_write` 工具 |
| `node test/reminders.mjs`（34 项） | 飞书调度：到期判定、每个时段只推一次、6 小时宽限、推送后自动完成、升级前已提醒任务的一次性归位、签名、错误上报、设置校验 |
| `node test/ui.mjs`（73 项） | 在 jsdom 里渲染的浏览器半边：slot 注册、待办行、三种悬停卡、添加表单的默认值、首次引导、带两个开关的提醒设置卡 |

dsh-tasks-panel README · 开发：全部对着真实的 bundle 跑，不 mock 自己的代码。宿主套件用假的 Cordis context 和内存表 import `index.js`；UI 套件通过假的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 加载 `client.js`，把面板渲染进 jsdom。全程不联网：飞书调用是打桩的 `fetch`，只记录它本来会发出去的 payload。

GitHub Actions 在每次 push 和 pull request 上用 Node 20 和 22 跑同一套测试，并用 OIDC trusted publishing 从 tag 发布到 npm（见 `.github/workflows/`）。
